public.apec_link_targets
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.apec_link_targets(p_institution_id text, p_fiscal_year integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT coalesce(private.has_staff_role(ARRAY['ADMIN','DATA_MANAGER']),false) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'APEC staff required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'projects',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'title',title) ORDER BY id) FROM public.budget_projects WHERE institution_id=p_institution_id AND fiscal_year=p_fiscal_year),'[]'::jsonb),
    'budgets',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id) ORDER BY id) FROM public.local_budgets WHERE institution_id=p_institution_id AND fiscal_year=p_fiscal_year AND status='PUBLISHED'),'[]'::jsonb)
  );
END $function$

functions.name: public.handle_new_user
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public.profiles (id, email, full_name, role)
  VALUES (
    new.id, 
    new.email, 
    COALESCE(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name', new.raw_user_meta_data->>'name', split_part(new.email, '@', 1)),
    'CITIZEN'
  )
  ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
    email = EXCLUDED.email,
    updated_at = timezone('utc'::text, now());
  RETURN new;
END;
$function$

functions.name: private.has_staff_role
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.has_staff_role(allowed_roles text[])
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ select exists(select 1 from public.profiles p where p.id=auth.uid() and p.is_active=true and p.role::text=any(allowed_roles)) $function$

functions.name: public.protect_profile_privileges
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.protect_profile_privileges()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if auth.uid()=old.id and not private.has_staff_role(array['ADMIN']) then
    if new.role is distinct from old.role or new.is_active is distinct from old.is_active then
      raise exception 'Role and account status cannot be changed by the profile owner';
    end if;
  end if;
  return new;
end
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.published_citizen_proofs()
 RETURNS TABLE(id text, project_id text, project_title text, commune_name text, region_name text, citizen_name text, image_url text, video_url text, media_type text, citizen_status_claim text, comment text, locality_details text, geo_latitude numeric, geo_longitude numeric, verification_status text, confirmations_count integer, created_at timestamp with time zone, updated_at timestamp with time zone, signboard_status text, secondary_image_url text, verified_at timestamp with time zone, source_url text, source_credit text, additional_photos text[])
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select p.id, p.project_id, p.project_title, p.commune_name, p.region_name,
    'Citoyen observateur'::text, p.image_url, p.video_url, p.media_type,
    p.citizen_status_claim, p.comment, p.locality_details,
    p.geo_latitude, p.geo_longitude, p.verification_status,
    p.confirmations_count, p.created_at, p.updated_at,
    p.signboard_status, p.secondary_image_url, p.verified_at,
    p.source_url, p.source_credit, p.additional_photos
  from public.citizen_proofs p
  where p.verification_status = 'APPROVED'
$function$

functions.name: private.apec_submission_event
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.apec_submission_event()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='apec_needs' THEN
    INSERT INTO public.apec_events(need_id,actor_id,kind,body,source_reference,source_date,provenance)
    VALUES (NEW.id,NEW.user_id,'SUBMITTED',NEW.description,NEW.source_reference,NEW.source_date,'CITIZEN_OBSERVATION');
  ELSE
    INSERT INTO public.apec_events(need_id,contribution_id,actor_id,kind,body,source_reference,source_date,provenance)
    VALUES (NEW.need_id,NEW.id,NEW.user_id,'CONTRIBUTION','Contribution reçue, à vérifier',NEW.source_reference,NEW.source_date,'CITIZEN_OBSERVATION');
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

constraints.name: buckets_lifecycle_configuration_shape_check
constraints.definition:
CHECK (((lifecycle_configuration IS NULL) OR ((jsonb_typeof(lifecycle_configuration) = 'object'::text) AND (lifecycle_configuration ? 'rules'::text) AND
CASE
    WHEN (jsonb_typeof((lifecycle_configuration -> 'rules'::text)) = 'array'::text) THEN ((jsonb_array_length((lifecycle_configuration -> 'rules'::text)) >= 1) AND (jsonb_array_length((lifecycle_configuration -> 'rules'::text)) <= 1000))
    ELSE false
END)))

constraints.name: buckets_lifecycle_configuration_standard_only_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((type = 'STANDARD'::storage.buckettype) OR ((lifecycle_configuration IS NULL) AND (lifecycle_configuration_generation IS NULL))))
